claim: Sensitivity to seven named instruction contracts on one fictional 50-adult roster and four fixed model configurations. Not representative language, national-population or LLM-family effects.
missingness: Never zero-fill failures or undefined endpoints. Require all four models in both arms per schedule. Report complete-block summaries and bounded missing-data extremes. Suppress primary inference if any planned block is incomplete.
inference: Paired schedule-block t diagnostics, Holm across exactly 24 hypotheses, Bonferroni simultaneous intervals. Assumes independent blocks and an adequate approximation for their mean. No equivalence or guaranteed power claim.
secondary: All categorical Coleman indices, age assortativity, modularity, degree distribution, per-model contrasts and matched controls remain descriptive. Do not select a primary from the strongest calibration result.
transport: SDK retries zero; automatic replacement retries zero. Reuse received responses. Any unresolved attempt blocks paid resume and retains its reservation. A general automatic-recovery runner is not approved by this document.
